submission.justification: No project document gives a GWP100 value for any candidate, so the hard GWP ≤ 150 limit is unverified for all three. This choice is provisional until someone confirms the GWP values. G2 is based on newer replacement gases, so it is the most likely to meet the limit. G3 is the standard fluorinated mixture and almost certainly exceeds it. G1 only partly substitutes the fluorinated component, so it probably exceeds it too. G2 is the slowest candidate: its best simulated resolution is 1.97 ns at 2 mm, against 1.31 ns for G1 and 0.9 ns for G3 (2025 figure). If G1's GWP turns out to be ≤150, it would be the better choice at 2 mm. G2's simulated resolution at 1/2/3 mm was 2.26/1.97/2.24 ns, so 2 mm is its optimum.

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document gives GWP values. G2 is judged most likely to comply because it uses newer replacement gases, but this is not confirmed.
The 2 mm gap is within range.
G2 gives 1.97 ns at 2 mm. This is the best result among mixtures that are plausibly compliant, but G1 (1.31 ns) and G3 (0.9 ns) are faster. Whether they meet the GWP limit is unverified.
This submission recommends G2 at 2 mm.
